subject: general
question: In which city is the headquarters of the International Rice Research Institute located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Los Banos**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Rice Research Institute (IRRI)** is a global agricultural research and training organisation with offices in seventeen countries and headquarters in** Los Banos, Laguna, Philippines.**
 
• IRRI is well-known for its role in producing rice varieties that contributed to the 1960s Green Revolution, which helped Asia avoid starvation.
 
• The Institute was founded in 1960 with the goal of reducing poverty and hunger, improving the health of rice farmers and consumers, and ensuring rice farming's environmental sustainability.
 
• It accomplishes its objective by collaborating on research, forming partnerships, and boosting the national agricultural research and extension systems of the countries in which it operates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Los Banos, **or the Municipality of Los Banos, is a first-class municipality in the Philippines' province of Laguna.
 
• It has a population of 115,353 people, according to the 2020 census.
 
• It is bounded on the south and south-west by Mount Makiling, on the north by Laguna de Bay, on the north-west by Calamba, and on the east by the town of Bay. It has a total land area of 56.5 square kilometres.
 
• **Indian Institute of Rice Research** formerly Directorate of Rice Research or IIRR is a rice research institute located in Rajendranagar near **Hyderabad**, Telangana.
